#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
using ll = long long;
const int MOD = 998244353;

int mod_pow(int a, int b, int mod) {
    ll res = 1, mul = a % mod;
    while (b > 0) {
        if (b & 1) res = res * mul % mod;
        mul = mul * mul % mod;
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return (int)res;
}

class FastScanner {
    char buf[1024];
    int ptr = 0, len = 0;
    bool hasNextByte() {
        if (ptr < len) return true;
        ptr = 0;
        len = fread(buf, 1, 1024, stdin);
        return len > 0;
    }
    char readByte() {
        return hasNextByte() ? buf[ptr++] : -1;
    }
    static bool isPrintable(char c) {
        return c > 32;
    }
    static bool isNumber(char c) {
        return '0' <= c && c <= '9';
    }
public:
    bool hasNext() {
        while (hasNextByte() && !isPrintable(buf[ptr])) ptr++;
        return hasNextByte();
    }
    string next() {
        if (!hasNext()) throw runtime_error("No such element");
        string res;
        char b;
        while (isPrintable(b = readByte())) res.push_back(b);
        return res;
    }
    long long nextLong() {
        if (!hasNext()) throw runtime_error("No such element");
        long long n = 0;
        char b = readByte();
        if (b == '-') {
            while (isNumber(b = readByte())) n = n * 10 + ('0' - b);
            return n;
        }
        if (!isNumber(b)) throw runtime_error("Not a number");
        do {
            n = n * 10 + (b - '0');
        } while (isNumber(b = readByte()));
        return n;
    }
    int nextInt() {
        return (int)nextLong();
    }
    double nextDouble() {
        return stod(next());
    }
};

int main() {
    FastScanner fs;
    int n = fs.nextInt();
    long long k = fs.nextLong();

    vector<long long> fact(n + 1), inv(n + 1);
    fact[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) fact[i + 1] = fact[i] * (i + 1) % MOD;
    inv[n] = mod_pow((int)fact[n], MOD - 2, MOD);
    for (int i = n; i > 0; --i) inv[i - 1] = inv[i] * i % MOD;

    auto comb = [&](int i, int j) -> long long {
        if (j < 0 || j > i) return 0;
        return fact[i] * inv[j] % MOD * inv[i - j] % MOD;
    };

    if (k == 0) {
        cout << fact[n] << "\n";
    } else if (k > n) {
        cout << 0 << "\n";
    } else {
        int k2 = (int)k;
        int k3 = n - k2;
        long long ans = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= k3; ++i) {
            long long tmp = comb(k3, i) * mod_pow(i, n, MOD) % MOD;
            if ((k3 - i) & 1) ans = (ans - tmp + MOD) % MOD;
            else ans = (ans + tmp) % MOD;
        }
        ans = ans * 2 % MOD;
        ans = ans * comb(n, k2) % MOD;
        cout << ans << "\n";
    }
    return 0;
}
